view.stem: 把 $P=\cos40^\circ\cos50^\circ$ 和 $Q=\cos\frac{\pi}{12}\cos\frac{5\pi}{12}$ 分别写成三角函数的和。哪一组变换都正确？

intent.task: Convert both complete cosine products into trigonometric sums; their fixed angle sums are right angles, in degrees and radians.
intent.source_solution: P=[cos(40+50)+cos(40-50)]/2=[cos90+cos10]/2. Q=[cos(pi/2)+cos(-pi/3)]/2=[cos(pi/2)+cos(pi/3)]/2. Cosine is even. Q also evaluates to 1/4, but evaluation alone would not fulfill this group's sum-conversion instruction.
intent.unit_reason: One complete pair compares the same right-angle-sum cosine-product mechanism across angle units. Both results must be valid, not separate angle or coefficient cells. Swapping a sum to a difference when the zero term comes first genuinely negates the result; swapping its order with a zero term would instead create an equivalent distractor and was excluded.
limitations: Recognition of two complete sums does not demonstrate independently writing either product-to-sum transformation.

rationales.derivation: Replace cos a cos b by [cos(2a)+cos(2b)]/2 instead of using a+b and a-b. This yields exactly the two displayed sums. Each is zero because its terms are supplementary cosines, whereas P>0 and Q=1/4.
rationales.misconception: Double each original angle independently, confusing power reduction with product-to-sum.

rationales.derivation: Use the correct sum and difference angles but omit division by 2. The displayed results are 2P and 2Q; neither product is zero.
rationales.misconception: Add the two cosine addition identities without dividing the resulting 2cos a cos b by 2.

rationales.derivation: Apply cos a cos b=[cos(a+b)+cos(a-b)]/2 and cos(-t)=cos t to each pair. This gives both displayed sums exactly.
Take cosine as odd in the difference angle: cos(-10)=-cos10 and cos(-pi/3)=-cos(pi/3). The resulting displayed sums are -P and -Q, since each angle-sum cosine is zero.
rationales.misconception: Use the sine oddness rule for cosine at negative difference angles.

view.stem: 把 $P=\sin\frac{5\pi}{24}\sin\frac{\pi}{24}$ 和 $Q=\sin110^\circ\sin50^\circ$ 分别写成三角函数的和。哪一组变换都正确？

intent.task: Convert both sine products into complete differences of cosine terms, preserving coefficient and subtraction order.
intent.source_solution: For P the difference is 4pi/24=pi/6 and the sum is 6pi/24=pi/4, so P=[cos(pi/6)-cos(pi/4)]/2. For Q the difference is 60 degrees and sum 160 degrees, so Q=[cos60-cos160]/2.
intent.unit_reason: The pair directly compares the same sine-product subtraction rule across angle units. It is not a set of individual angle computations. Both P and Q are positive and nonzero. The plus-form alternative is not equivalent because both sum-angle cosines are nonzero.
limitations: Choice recognition cannot establish unaided written conversion of either sine product.

rationales.derivation: Substitute the right sum and difference angles into the cosine-product plus rule instead of the sine-product minus rule. This produces the displayed plus signs; cos(pi/4) and cos160 are nonzero, so it does not give P or Q.
rationales.misconception: Apply the cos a cos b product-to-sum formula to sin a sin b.

rationales.derivation: Use sin a sin b=[cos(a-b)-cos(a+b)]/2 with the computed angles for each full product.
Compute the correct cosine differences but omit their factor 1/2, giving exactly 2P and 2Q.
rationales.misconception: Forget that subtracting the addition formulas yields twice the sine product.

rationales.derivation: Subtract the difference-angle cosine from the sum-angle cosine instead of the reverse. Each displayed expression is the negative of its positive original product.
rationales.misconception: Reverse the subtraction order in the sine-product formula.

view.stem: 设 $P=\sin(x+\frac{\pi}{4})\sin(x-\frac{\pi}{4})$，$Q=\sin(\alpha+\frac{\pi}{3})\sin(\alpha-\frac{\pi}{6})$。将两式积化和差并化简，哪一组对所有实数 $x,\alpha$ 都成立？

intent.task: Transform both full shifted sine products, including the unequal shifts in Q, as identities.
intent.source_solution: In P the difference of the arguments is pi/2 and their sum is 2x. Hence P=[cos(pi/2)-cos2x]/2=-cos2x/2. In Q the difference is pi/3+pi/6=pi/2 and the sum is 2alpha+pi/6, giving Q=-cos(2alpha+pi/6)/2.
intent.unit_reason: Both products eliminate their fixed difference-angle cosine but retain distinct variable angle sums. One full pair assesses that structural cancellation, including Q's residual shift, rather than separate shift cells. Universal validity is explicit: agreement at isolated variable values does not make alternatives equivalent.
limitations: Selecting a full identity pair does not demonstrate independently expanding the two argument sums and differences in writing.

rationales.derivation: Use [cos(sum)-cos(difference)]/2. With cos(pi/2)=0 this yields positive half-cosines, the negatives of P and Q.
rationales.misconception: Reverse the two cosine terms of the sine-product rule.

rationales.derivation: In the sum of arguments replace x+x by x and alpha+alpha by alpha, but keep the constant shifts and coefficient. This gives exactly the displayed undoubled variable arguments. At x=pi, P=-1/2 whereas this P-candidate is +1/2.
rationales.misconception: Cancel repeated variables in an addition as if adding the two arguments were subtracting them.

rationales.derivation: Keep the correctly doubled arguments and subtraction sign but omit division by 2. Both expressions are twice the original products.
rationales.misconception: Lose the product-to-sum coefficient after the zero term disappears.

rationales.derivation: Subtract arguments to obtain pi/2 in both cases, add them to obtain 2x and 2alpha+pi/6, and use the sine-product formula with cos(pi/2)=0.

view.stem: 把 $P=\cos(x+\beta)\cos(x-\beta)$ 与 $Q=\sin(x+\alpha)\sin(x-\alpha)$ 写成三角函数的和。哪一组对所有实数 $x,\alpha,\beta$ 都成立？

intent.task: Distinguish cosine and sine product-to-sum transformations for complete symmetric argument pairs.
intent.source_solution: The arguments in P have sum 2x and difference 2beta, so P=(cos2x+cos2beta)/2. Those in Q have sum 2x and difference 2alpha, so Q=(cos2alpha-cos2x)/2. All variables are unrestricted real numbers.
intent.unit_reason: The cosine/sine contrast on symmetric arguments is one coherent paired judgment. Their sum and difference roles must be preserved together, not split into per-term answers. Special-value coincidences are excluded by the all-real-values condition.
limitations: A selected formula pair is not evidence of unaided algebraic derivation of the two transformations.

rationales.derivation: Apply the plus cosine-product rule to P and the difference-minus-sum sine-product rule to Q with arguments 2x, 2beta and 2alpha.
Use averages of the arguments, (a+b)/2 and (a-b)/2, where product-to-sum requires their sum and difference. This gives x,beta and x,alpha. For x=pi,beta=0, the P-candidate is 0 whereas P=1.
rationales.misconception: Import the half-angle arguments from sum-to-product into product-to-sum.

rationales.derivation: Use the sine-product rule for P to get [cos2beta-cos2x]/2, and the cosine-product rule for Q to get [cos2x+cos2alpha]/2. At all variables zero, the claimed pair is (0,1) instead of (1,0).
rationales.misconception: Exchange the cosine and sine product formulas.

rationales.derivation: Retain all correct angles and signs but omit the factor 1/2, doubling both identities.
rationales.misconception: Do not divide the added or subtracted angle-addition formulas by 2.

view.stem: 把 $P=4\sin30^\circ\sin20^\circ\sin10^\circ$ 和 $Q=4\cos60^\circ\cos20^\circ\cos10^\circ$ 完全写成三角函数的和。哪一组正确？

intent.task: Fully transform the two three-factor products, exploiting exact sin30 and cos60 without leaving a product.
intent.source_solution: sin30=cos60=1/2, so P=2sin20sin10=cos10-cos30 and Q=2cos20cos10=cos30+cos10. The requested sums retain their different signs.
intent.unit_reason: Both tasks share the same removable half-valued factor and the same 20/10 degree angles. A full paired response directly tests the remaining sine/cosine sign distinction without per-factor splitting. P>0 since cos10>cos30, and Q>0; no two displayed complete pairs coincide.
limitations: Recognizing the complete pair does not show independent written simplification of either original three-factor product.

rationales.derivation: After correctly reducing both first factors to 2, apply the cosine-product plus rule to both remaining products. P becomes cos10+cos30 rather than the difference; Q remains correct.
rationales.misconception: Treat the remaining sine product as a cosine product.

rationales.derivation: Evaluate the half-valued factors, then use 2sin20sin10=cos10-cos30 and 2cos20cos10=cos30+cos10.
Reverse sine-product subtraction for P to get cos30-cos10, and apply the sine-product difference rule to Q to get cos10-cos30. The first is negative, unlike P, and the second lacks Q's +cos30 term.
rationales.misconception: Use a difference for both products while reversing its order in the sine case.

rationales.derivation: Reduce the half-valued factors correctly, but replace sin20sin10 and cos20cos10 by full cosine differences/sums without their 1/2 factors. This doubles the correct pair.
rationales.misconception: Lose the product-to-sum half after evaluating sin30 and cos60.

view.stem: 把 $4\sin25^\circ\cos15^\circ\sin5^\circ$ 完全写成三角函数的和，哪一个式子与原式相等？

intent.task: Eliminate every product in the complete mixed three-factor expression by two product-to-sum stages.
intent.source_solution: 4sin25cos15sin5=2(cos20-cos30)cos15. Expanding the two cosine products gives cos35+cos5-cos45-cos15. Independently, pairing sin25cos15 first gives 2(sin40+sin10)sin5 and the same four terms.
intent.unit_reason: The whole four-term sum is the natural response, because the two expansions and distribution of the minus sign are linked. It is not split into individual terms. A differs from C by 2(cos15-cos5), which is nonzero; B is half C; D adds 2(cos45+cos15).
limitations: Selecting the four-term sum does not demonstrate independently carrying out both expansion stages and their sign distribution.

rationales.derivation: First obtain 2(cos20-cos30)cos15 correctly. Then use 2cos a cos b=cos(a+b)-cos(a-b), producing cos35-cos5-(cos45-cos15), exactly A.
rationales.misconception: Introduce a minus sign in the cosine-product rule at the second expansion stage.

rationales.derivation: Carry out all angle and sign expansions correctly but retain an extra 1/2 from one expansion, giving half the entire correct four-term sum.
rationales.misconception: Fail to cancel the prefactor 2 against the second product-to-sum half.

rationales.derivation: Use 2sin25sin5=cos20-cos30, then expand both 2cos20cos15 and 2cos30cos15 with plus signs and distribute the outer subtraction.
Replace 2sin25sin5 by cos20+cos30, then correctly expand both cosine products. All four resulting cosines have plus signs, exactly as displayed.
rationales.misconception: Use the cosine-product plus sign for the initial sine product.

view.stem: 把 $8\cos1^\circ\cos2^\circ\cos4^\circ\cos8^\circ$ 完全写成三角函数的和，哪一个式子与原式相等？

intent.task: Convert the entire four-factor product into a sum, tracking all branches, coefficients and negative cosine arguments.
intent.source_solution: 8cos1cos2cos4cos8=4(cos3+cos1)cos4cos8=2(cos7+cos1+cos5+cos3)cos8. The final expansion yields cos15+cos(-1)+cos9+cos(-7)+cos13+cos(-3)+cos11+cos(-5). Cosine evenness gives the eight odd-angle terms from 1 through 15, each with coefficient 1.
intent.unit_reason: All eight branches belong to one linked expansion and are offered as complete sums, not eight separate clicks. A halves a positive sum; B removes twice the four positive low-angle cosines; C reverses the four positive terms arising from cos3. Thus the differently signed sums are not equivalent. No other question supplies this final eight-term expansion.
limitations: Recognition of the complete eight-term expansion cannot prove unaided generation and tracking of every expansion branch.

rationales.derivation: The three product-to-sum stages contribute (1/2)^3, canceled by 8. Mistakenly count four such stages for four factors, giving 8(1/2)^4=1/2 times the otherwise correct eight-term sum.
rationales.misconception: Count one halving per factor rather than one per binary product expansion.

rationales.derivation: Obtain the final unsimplified angles 15,-1,9,-7,13,-3,11,-5, then incorrectly set cos(-t)=-cos t. Sorting these terms gives exactly B.
rationales.misconception: Treat cosine as odd when removing negative final difference angles.

rationales.derivation: At the first pairing use 2cos1cos2=cos1-cos3. The remaining correct expansions of 4cos1cos4cos8 give cos13+cos3+cos11+cos5; those of -4cos3cos4cos8 give -cos15-cos1-cos9-cos7. Sorting gives C.
rationales.misconception: Apply the sine-product difference formula at the first cosine-product pairing.

rationales.derivation: Expand each of the three binary product stages with the cosine plus rule, cancel 8 against three halves, and use cosine evenness on the four negative difference arguments.

view.stem: 把 $2\sin22^\circ30'\cos7^\circ30'$ 写成便于不查表计算的形式，并算出精确值。哪一条计算链每一步都正确？

intent.task: Rewrite the full degree-minute sine-cosine product for no-table calculation AND evaluate it exactly.
intent.source_solution: The angles are 22.5 and 7.5 degrees. Twice the sine-cosine product is sin30+sin15. Derive sin15=sin(45-30)=(sqrt2/2)(sqrt3/2)-(sqrt2/2)(1/2)=(sqrt6-sqrt2)/4. Add sin30=1/2 to obtain (2+sqrt6-sqrt2)/4, without a table.
intent.unit_reason: A complete chain preserves both required tasks, rather than offering just a numeric value or just an intermediate sum. A and D deliberately share the correct transformation so that identifying the appropriate product-to-sum rule alone does not settle the exact calculation. All candidate values differ since sin15 is positive and nonzero.
limitations: Recognition of the complete chain does not show unaided written product conversion or derivation of the exact special-angle value without tables.

rationales.derivation: Compute the sum/difference angles as 30 and 15 degrees, use 2sin a cos b=sin(a+b)+sin(a-b), and derive sin15 from sin(45-30). Both displayed equalities are exact.
Use sin(a+b)-sin(a-b) instead of plus for 2sin a cos b. Correctly evaluate that mistaken difference as (2-sqrt6+sqrt2)/4, yielding B.
rationales.misconception: Use the identity for 2cos a sin b in place of 2sin a cos b.

rationales.derivation: Apply the half-sum formula for sin a cos b but ignore the leading 2. The resulting half of sin30+sin15 evaluates to the displayed denominator 8.
rationales.misconception: Fail to cancel the original leading 2 with the product-to-sum half.

rationales.misconception: Use sine addition instead of subtraction when deriving sin15.

view.stem: 设 $P=\cos45^\circ\cos15^\circ$，$Q=\sin\frac{\pi}{4}\sin\frac{\pi}{12}$，$R=\cos\frac{\pi}{12}\cos\frac{\pi}{4}$。把三式写成便于不查表计算的形式，并算出精确值。哪一组计算链全部正确？

intent.task: Exactly transform and evaluate all three printed products without tables, while recognizing the degree-radian equivalence of the two cosine products and the different sine-product sign.
intent.source_solution: 45 degrees=pi/4 and 15 degrees=pi/12. Thus P=R by multiplication commutativity. Their sum and absolute difference angles are pi/3 and pi/6, so P=R=[cos(pi/3)+cos(pi/6)]/2=(1+sqrt3)/4. Q=[cos(pi/6)-cos(pi/3)]/2=(sqrt3-1)/4. The special-angle values cos(pi/6)=sqrt3/2 and cos(pi/3)=1/2 give exact results without a table.
intent.unit_reason: This meaningful joint comparison incorporates the identical tasks 279 and 282 once, instead of allowing a previous keyed degree-form answer to cue a duplicate radian-form question. Task 281 uses precisely the same angles with sine factors, so the sign and exact-value contrast is substantive. Every candidate supplies both transformation and value for all three products; no individual value cell is split out.
limitations: Choice recognition of the joint chains is not independent written conversion and exact evaluation of any of the three original expressions.

rationales.derivation: After correctly identifying P=R, use the sine-product minus rule for the cosine products and the cosine-product plus rule for Q. Correctly evaluating those mistaken transformed expressions gives the two exchanged values.
rationales.misconception: Exchange sine and cosine product-to-sum signs on the same angle pair.

rationales.derivation: Write the right trigonometric sums, but evaluate (1/2)(sqrt3/2 +/- 1/2) as (sqrt3 +/- 1)/2, dropping the outer half during arithmetic. Both numerical conclusions double the true values.
rationales.misconception: Forget the outer coefficient when substituting exact cosine values.

rationales.derivation: Transform all products correctly, but substitute cos(pi/3)=1 instead of 1/2. Then (1/2)(sqrt3/2 +/- 1)=(sqrt3 +/- 2)/4, exactly C.
rationales.misconception: Confuse the value of cosine at 60 degrees with its value at zero.

rationales.derivation: Convert degrees to radians, identify the equal cosine products, apply the respective plus/minus product formulas, and substitute sqrt3/2 and 1/2 while preserving the outer half.

view.stem: 把 $\sin52^\circ30'\sin7^\circ30'$ 写成便于不查表计算的形式，并算出精确值。哪一条计算链每一步都正确？

intent.task: Perform the full no-table transformation and exact evaluation of the degree-minute sine product.

It is distinct from the 45/15 degree sine task: its sum and difference are 60/45, not 60/30. The nearby square-root forms therefore must not be reused from another question. rationales.derivation: Use the correct difference of cosines but omit its factor 1/2. Evaluating it gives (sqrt2-1)/2, twice the product.

Reverse the order of the cosine difference, then evaluate it correctly as (1-sqrt2)/4. This is negative whereas both original sine factors are positive.

view.stem: 设 $T=8\cos10^\circ\cos50^\circ\cos70^\circ$，$S=\sin20^\circ\sin40^\circ\sin60^\circ\sin80^\circ$。把 $T$ 写成便于不查表计算的形式并算出精确值，再判断 $S=\frac3{16}$ 是否成立。哪一项的计算链和判断全部正确？

intent.task: Fully rewrite and exactly compute the starred three-cosine product without tables, then decide the complete four-sine equality by a valid cofunction equivalence inference.
intent.source_solution: T=8cos10cos50cos70=4(cos60+cos40)cos70=2cos70+2(cos110+cos30). Since cos110=-cos70, this leaves 2cos30=sqrt3. Independently solve the equality task: 4sin20sin40sin80=2sin20(cos40-cos120)=2sin20cos40+sin20=sin60, so S=sin^2 60/4=3/16. To connect the two complete tasks, sin20=cos70, sin40=cos50 and sin80=cos10, so S=(T/8)sin60=(sqrt3/8)(sqrt3/2)=3/16 exactly.
intent.unit_reason: These source tasks use the identical three-factor product under cofunction rewriting: a separate exact T question would directly cue the equality decision. One joint complete chain instead requires the full no-table cosine calculation and the decisive equivalence inference for S. No task is split into cells. Three alternatives suffice; every scalar conclusion is generated by a concrete coefficient procedure, not a nearby invented value.
limitations: Recognition of the full exact chain does not prove independently finding the cancellation or writing the computation without tables.
Using the joint cosine-product calculation narrows the equality task's open solution route; recognition does not establish independently writing its cofunction or sine-product justification.

Substitute this mistaken T into the valid relation S=(T/8)sin60 to get 3/8 and the false equality decision. Its initial product conversion is invalid.

view.stem: 降低 $P=2\cos^2 x$ 和 $Q=2\sin^2 2x$ 中三角函数的次数。哪一组结果对所有实数 $x$ 都成立？

intent.task: Reduce both complete squared expressions to first-power trigonometric terms, distinguishing cosine/sine signs and the inner 2x.
intent.source_solution: Put equal arguments into the product formulas: cos^2 t=(1+cos2t)/2 and sin^2 t=(1-cos2t)/2. With the original factors 2, P=1+cos2x and Q=1-cos4x.
intent.unit_reason: The pair contrasts the plus/minus square formulas and argument doubling on full expressions. It is one structural judgment, not individual constant and frequency cells. Universal validity rules out isolated coincidences: at x=0 signs distinguish A and B; at x=pi, C disagrees with P; D halves the pair.

view.stem: 降低 $2\cos^2 x\cos2x$ 中三角函数的次数，并化为不含三角函数乘积的和。哪一个结果对所有实数 $x$ 都成立？

intent.task: Lower all powers in the full squared-cosine product, including the square created by multiplication after the first reduction.

A halves C; B doubles just its constant and 4x term; D reverses the 4x term, so no candidate is identically equivalent.

Reach cos2x+cos^2 2x, then replace cos^2 2x by (1-cos4x)/2. This yields the displayed negative 4x term.

view.stem: 降低 $P=\sin^2 6x$ 和 $Q=\cos^2 4x$ 中三角函数的次数。哪一组结果对所有实数 $x$ 都成立？

intent.task: Lower both complete sine and cosine squares with their full multiplied variable arguments.
intent.source_solution: sin^2 t=(1-cos2t)/2 with t=6x gives P=(1-cos12x)/2. cos^2 t=(1+cos2t)/2 with t=4x gives Q=(1+cos8x)/2.
